title: Alien Guide on Alien World
description: A black and white line drawing depicts a young hiker with a backpack and walking stick standing on a rocky path. A large, winged insectoid alien with multiple eyes holds a circular mirror reflecting the scene, set against a purple terrain with floating geometric crystals under a red cratered planet in a starry sky.
